column3: Close to the Hebrew; “the Morasthite” is rendered “of Moresheth.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in you” is rendered “against you.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the heap of ruins of the field” is rendered “a heap of ruins in the field.”
Close to the Hebrew; “all its hires” is rendered “all her pay as a harlot.”
Close to the Hebrew; “barefoot” is rendered “stripped,” and “the daughters of the ostrich” “the ostriches.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Beth Leaphrah” is rendered “Beth Aphrah.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the lament of Beth Ezel will take from you its standing place” is rendered “Beth Ezel mourns; Its place to stand is taken away from you”; the wordplay on names is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “she is in anguish for good” is rendered “pined for good.”
Close to the Hebrew; “parting gifts” is rendered “presents,” and “a deceitful thing” “a lie.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the one who dispossesses” is rendered “an heir.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the children of your delights” is rendered “your precious children.”
